examples.en: If you come across the bridge, my house is right there.
The kid from next door came over to our house.
I ran into a friend while crossing the road to this side.

examples.ko: 강 건너편 마을에서 배를 타고 건너와요.
examples.en: People cross over by boat from the village on the other side of the river.
A letter that came across the sea arrived today.
Come over to this side and sit together.

explain: '건너다'는 방향이 없지만 '건너오다'는 말하는 사람 쪽으로 넘어올 때 써요. 반대로 저쪽으로 갈 때는 '건너가다'라고 해요. 길, 다리, 강, 바다처럼 사이에 있는 것을 지나 올 때 자연스러워요.

phrases.en: Please come across from that side of the road to this side.
phrases.nuance_ko: '건너오다'를 높여 부탁할 때 쓰는 말로, 말하는 사람 쪽으로 오라고 해요.
phrases.nuance_en: A polite request form of 건너오다, asking someone to come over to the speaker's side.

phrases.en: I can see a child coming across the street.
phrases.nuance_ko: 사이에 있는 길을 지나 이쪽으로 올 때 자주 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common pairing for crossing a road toward the speaker.

phrases.en: If you come across the river, the market is right there.
phrases.nuance_ko: 강을 지나 이쪽으로 올 때 쓰고, '다리를 건너오다'와 비슷하게 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for crossing a river toward the speaker, like 다리를 건너오다.

explain_en: '건너다' has no direction, but '건너오다' is used when someone crosses toward the speaker's side. When going the other way, you say '건너가다'. It sounds natural for passing over something in between, like a road, bridge, river or sea.

examples.en: Airport buses have plenty of room for luggage.

examples.ko: 공항버스를 타면 공항까지 한 시간쯤 걸려요.
examples.en: If you take the airport bus, it takes about an hour to the airport.

examples.ko: 공항버스 정류장이 호텔 바로 앞에 있어요.
examples.en: The airport bus stop is right in front of the hotel.
It's an early-morning flight, so we decided to go by airport bus.
Please check the airport bus timetable in advance.
I have a lot of luggage, so the airport bus is more convenient than the subway.

explain: 짐을 실을 공간이 있어서 공항에 갈 때 많이 타요. '공항 리무진'이라고도 불러요. 일반 시내버스와 달리 공항 노선을 따로 운행해요.

phrases.en: You can also take the airport limousine bus in front of the hotel.
phrases.nuance_ko: '공항버스'와 같은 뜻으로 쓰는 다른 이름이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Another name that means the same as 공항버스.

phrases.en: I took the airport bus early in the morning.
phrases.nuance_ko: 버스에 올라 이동할 때는 '타다'를 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: 타다 is the verb for riding a bus.

phrases.en: The airport bus stop is over there.
phrases.nuance_ko: 버스를 기다리는 곳을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The place where you wait for the bus.

explain_en: It has space for luggage, so many people take it to the airport. It is also called '공항 리무진'. Unlike an ordinary city bus, it runs on its own airport routes.

examples.en: I went on a group trip by tour bus.

examples.ko: 관광버스는 출발 시간을 꼭 지켜야 해요.
examples.en: For a tour bus, you must keep to the departure time.
The tour bus arrived at the mountain entrance.
We shared snacks on the tour bus.
Traveling by tour bus is easy even if you don't know the way.
People boarded the tour bus one after another.

explain: 여행객이 단체로 타고 관광지를 다니는 버스예요. 시내버스나 시외버스와 달리 여러 명이 빌려 타는 경우가 많아요. 학교 소풍이나 단체 여행 이야기에 자주 나와요.

phrases.en: I went to Gyeongju with my family on a tour bus.
phrases.nuance_ko: 여행하려고 단체 버스에 오를 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for boarding a group bus for a trip.

phrases.en: We moved by tour bus.
phrases.nuance_ko: '-(으)로'는 이동 수단을 나타내요.
phrases.nuance_en: -(으)로 marks the means of travel.

phrases.en: We rented a tour bus for the alumni gathering.
phrases.nuance_ko: 단체가 돈을 내고 버스를 쓸 때 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when a group pays to use a bus.

explain_en: It is a bus that groups of travelers ride to visit tourist spots. Unlike city or intercity buses, it is often rented by a group. It frequently comes up in stories about school outings and group trips.

examples.ko: 목포는 한반도의 남서쪽 끝에 있는 바닷가 도시예요.
examples.en: Mokpo is a seaside city at the southwestern end of the Korean Peninsula.
Today the wind blows from the southwest.
The southwest sky has turned red.

examples.ko: 학교에서 남서쪽으로 오 분만 걸으면 저희 집이에요.
examples.en: If you walk five minutes southwest from the school, you reach my house.
Look for the southwest direction on the map.

examples.ko: 이 산의 남서쪽 길은 경사가 심해요.
examples.en: The southwest trail of this mountain is steep.

explain: 방위 이름은 '북동, 북서, 남동, 남서'처럼 북·남을 먼저 말해요. '남서쪽에서 불다'는 출발점, '남서쪽으로 가다'는 가는 방향이라 조사가 달라요. 같은 방향을 '서남쪽'이라고 하는 사람도 있어요.

phrases.example: 서남쪽으로 조금 더 가면 바다가 나와요.
phrases.en: If you go a little farther southwest, you reach the sea.
phrases.nuance_ko: 같은 방향을 서쪽을 먼저 말해서 부르는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The same direction, naming west first.

phrases.en: We are heading southwest.
phrases.nuance_ko: '으로'는 가는 방향을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: 'Euro' marks the direction you are going.

phrases.en: The wind blows from the southwest.
phrases.nuance_ko: '에서'는 출발점을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: 'Eseo' marks the starting point.

explain_en: Korean compass names put north or south first: 북동, 북서, 남동, 남서. The particles differ: '남서쪽에서 불다' (blow from) marks the starting point, '남서쪽으로 가다' (go toward) the direction. Some people also say '서남쪽' for the same direction.

examples.en: There is a persimmon tree in our backyard.
The children play ball in the backyard.
I'm thinking of making a vegetable patch in the backyard.
The startled puppy ran out to the backyard.
I mowed the backyard lawn on the weekend.
Our backyard is quieter than the front yard.

explain: 앞마당의 반대말이에요. 비슷한 말로 '뒤뜰'도 있어요. 마당이 있는 단독주택 이야기에서 자주 나오고 아파트에는 보통 없어요.

phrases.en: The puppy plays in the backyard.
phrases.nuance_ko: 어디에서 하는 일인지 말할 때 '에서'를 붙여요.
phrases.nuance_en: Add 에서 to say where an action happens.

phrases.en: There are many pretty flowers in the back garden.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뒷마당과 비슷한 말이에요. 조금 더 정원 같은 느낌이 있어요.
phrases.nuance_en: A similar word to 뒷마당, with a slightly more garden-like feel.

phrases.en: I put a chair in the backyard.
phrases.nuance_ko: 물건을 어디에 두는지 말할 때 '에'와 '놓다'를 함께 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use 에 with 놓다 to say where you put something.

explain_en: It is the opposite of '앞마당' (front yard). A similar word is '뒤뜰'. It comes up when talking about houses with a yard, and apartments usually don't have one.

examples.en: There's a good little restaurant near my office.
For lunch I eat a set meal at a neighborhood restaurant.

examples.ko: 이 밥집은 반찬이 정말 많이 나와요.
examples.en: This restaurant serves a lot of side dishes.

examples.ko: 퇴근하고 혼자 밥집에 들러서 저녁을 먹었어요.
examples.en: After work I stopped by a small restaurant and had dinner alone.
The lady at the restaurant gave me more side dishes.

examples.ko: 이 근처에 괜찮은 밥집 좀 알아요?
examples.en: Do you know any decent place to eat around here?

explain: '식당'보다 가볍고 친근한 말로, 밥과 찌개, 반찬을 파는 작은 가게 느낌이에요. 커피를 파는 '카페'나 술을 파는 '술집'과 대비해서 쓰기도 해요.

phrases.en: I had dinner at a neighborhood restaurant.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가깝고 편한 작은 가게라는 느낌이 더 강해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Gives a stronger feeling of a close, casual little place.

phrases.en: I usually eat lunch at a small restaurant.
phrases.nuance_ko: 밥을 먹으러 가는 곳을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for the place where you go to eat a meal.
phrases.en_equiv: to eat at a small restaurant

phrases.example: 회사 앞 식당은 항상 사람이 많아요.
phrases.en: The restaurant in front of my office is always crowded.
phrases.nuance_ko: '밥집'보다 더 넓게 쓰는 일반적인 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A more general word than 밥집.

explain_en: It is a lighter, friendlier word than '식당', suggesting a small place serving rice, stew and side dishes. It is also used in contrast with '카페' for coffee or '술집' for drinks.

examples.en: On the weekend I went to the bowling alley with friends.
I rented shoes at the bowling alley.

examples.ko: 이 볼링장은 레인이 스무 개나 돼요.
examples.en: This bowling alley has as many as twenty lanes.
A new bowling alley opened near my house.
It takes about ten minutes to walk to the bowling alley.

examples.ko: 볼링장 안은 소리가 커서 말이 잘 안 들려요.
examples.en: It's loud inside the bowling alley, so it's hard to hear each other.

explain: '-장'은 장소를 나타내서 수영장, 주차장, 운동장처럼 써요. 볼링은 '치다'와 함께 써서 '볼링을 치다'라고 해요.

phrases.en: Bowling relieves my stress.
phrases.nuance_ko: 볼링은 '치다'와 함께 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Bowling goes with the verb 치다.

phrases.en: On weekends I hang out with friends at the bowling alley.
phrases.nuance_ko: 그곳에서 시간을 보낸다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means spending time there.
phrases.en_equiv: to hang out at the bowling alley

phrases.en: The nearby bowling alley is closed.
phrases.nuance_ko: 위치를 앞에 붙여 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Put the location in front to specify it.

explain_en: The suffix '-장' marks a place, as in 수영장, 주차장 and 운동장. Bowling goes with '치다', so you say '볼링을 치다'.

examples.en: Gangwon Province is to the northeast when seen from Seoul.
If you go northeast, you will reach the sea.
Last night the typhoon slowly passed toward the northeast.

examples.ko: 우리 집 북동쪽에 큰 시장이 있어요.
examples.en: There is a big market northeast of our house.
The morning sun comes in through the northeast window.

examples.ko: 지도에서 북동쪽 끝까지 기차로 갈 수 있어요.
examples.en: You can go to the far northeast of the map by train.

explain: 같은 방향을 '동북쪽'이라고도 해요. '동북아시아'처럼 이름이 굳은 말에서는 '동북'을 써요. [북똥쪽]으로 소리 나는 것도 외워 두세요.

phrases.en: If you go northeast, you will see mountains.
phrases.nuance_ko: 같은 방향을 동쪽을 먼저 말해서 부르는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The same direction, naming east first.

phrases.en: That city is to the northeast of here.
phrases.nuance_ko: 위치를 말할 때 '에 있다'를 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use 'e itda' to say where something is.

phrases.en: The rain clouds are coming from the northeast.
phrases.nuance_ko: '에서'는 출발점을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: 'Eseo' marks the starting point.

explain_en: The same direction can also be '동북쪽'. Set names like '동북아시아' (Northeast Asia) use '동북'. Also remember it is pronounced [buk-ttong-jjok].

examples.en: Every morning the school bus comes to the front of the apartment building.
My child missed the school bus, so I drove him.
What time does the school bus arrive at school?

examples.ko: 우리 학교는 스쿨버스로 통학하는 학생이 많아요.
examples.en: At our school, many students commute by school bus.
On the field trip day, we went by school bus.
I sang songs with my friend on the school bus.

explain: '통학버스'라는 말도 비슷하게 써요. 학원에서 아이들을 태우는 차는 보통 '학원 버스'라고 해요. '타다, 내리다, 놓치다'와 자주 함께 써요.

phrases.example: 아이는 매일 스쿨버스를 타고 학교에 가요.
phrases.en: My child takes the school bus to school every day.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가장 자주 쓰는 기본 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common basic collocation.

phrases.en: I overslept and missed the school bus.
phrases.nuance_ko: 시간에 늦어서 타지 못했을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when you are late and fail to catch it.

phrases.en: Our school has a commuter bus.
phrases.nuance_ko: '스쿨버스'와 비슷한 뜻으로 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A word with a meaning similar to 'seukulbeoseu'.

explain_en: '통학버스' (commuter bus for students) is used in a similar way. A bus that picks up kids for a private academy is usually called a '학원 버스'. It often goes with the verbs '타다' (ride), '내리다' (get off) and '놓치다' (miss).

examples.en: Stand the umbrella up beside the door.
It's faster if you take the side road.
There's a small chair on the side of the bookshelf.
If you go around the side of the building, you'll find the parking lot.
May I sit in the seat over there on the side?
I was startled when a car suddenly came out from the side.

explain: '옆'은 바로 곁을 가리키고, '옆쪽'은 그 방향이나 조금 넓은 범위를 말할 때 어울려요. '앞쪽, 뒤쪽, 옆쪽'처럼 방향을 나타내는 말과 같이 외우면 좋아요. 길을 설명할 때 '옆쪽으로 돌아가세요'처럼 써요.

phrases.en: If you go to the side of the convenience store, there is a bank.
phrases.nuance_ko: 길이나 방향을 알려 줄 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when giving directions.

phrases.en: There is a parking lot on the side of the building.
phrases.nuance_ko: 어떤 장소의 옆 부분을 가리킬 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Points to the side part of a place.

phrases.en: The front door was closed, so I went in through the side door.
phrases.nuance_ko: 문, 길처럼 옆에 있는 것을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for things on the side, like a door or road.

explain_en: '옆' points to what is right beside you, while '옆쪽' fits the direction or a somewhat wider area. Learn it with '앞쪽' and '뒤쪽' (front side, back side). When giving directions, say things like '옆쪽으로 돌아가세요' (go around the side).

examples.en: It was raining a lot, so I called a taxi.
They say the taxi will arrive within five minutes.
Late at night, it is easier to book a call taxi.
How much would it cost to go to the airport by call taxi?

examples.ko: 할머니께서 병원에 가실 때 콜택시를 이용해요.
examples.en: My grandmother uses a call taxi when she goes to the hospital.
I sent the address to the call taxi driver by text message.

explain: 길에서 손을 들어 잡는 택시와 달리, 전화나 앱으로 '부르는' 택시예요. 그래서 '콜택시를 부르다/예약하다'처럼 같이 써요.

phrases.en: I called a taxi late at night.
phrases.nuance_ko: 전화나 앱으로 택시를 오게 할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when you get a taxi to come by phone or app.

phrases.example: 내일 아침 공항 가는 콜택시를 예약했어요.
phrases.en: I booked a taxi to the airport for tomorrow morning.
phrases.nuance_ko: 미리 시간을 정해 둘 때 '예약하다'를 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use 예약하다 when you set a time in advance.

phrases.en: The taxi has already come to my house.
phrases.nuance_ko: 부른 택시가 도착했을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when the taxi you called has arrived.

explain_en: Unlike a taxi you flag down on the street, this is a taxi you summon by phone or app. That is why it pairs with verbs like '부르다' (call) and '예약하다' (book).

examples.en: The child plays in the water wearing a swim ring.

examples.ko: 바다에 가기 전에 튜브에 바람을 넣었어요.
examples.en: Before going to the sea, I blew up the inflatable ring.

examples.ko: 저는 수영을 못해서 튜브가 꼭 필요해요.
examples.en: I can't swim, so I really need a float ring.

examples.ko: 치약 튜브가 거의 비어서 새로 샀어요.
examples.en: The toothpaste tube was almost empty, so I bought a new one.

examples.ko: 튜브를 탄 아이가 파도 위에서 웃고 있어요.
examples.en: The child riding the swim ring is laughing on the waves.
Where do I throw away a deflated float?

explain: 튜브는 보통 물놀이용 동그란 튜브를 말해요. 몸에 끼면 '튜브를 끼다', 위에 올라 놀면 '튜브를 타다'라고 해요. 치약처럼 짜 쓰는 통은 '치약 튜브'처럼 앞에 내용물 이름을 붙여요.

phrases.en: I can't swim, so I went in wearing a swim ring.
phrases.nuance_ko: 몸에 튜브를 끼우고 물에 들어갈 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when you put a swim ring around your body to go in the water.

phrases.en: The kids ride on inner tubes and play.
phrases.nuance_ko: 튜브 위에 올라 물에서 떠 있거나 놀 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when you sit on a tube and float or play on the water.

phrases.en: I bought a pool tube at the convenience store.
phrases.nuance_ko: 물놀이에 쓰는 튜브라는 점을 분명히 말할 때 앞에 '물놀이'를 붙여요.
phrases.nuance_en: '물놀이' is added to make clear it's a tube for water play.

explain_en: 튜브 usually means the round swim ring. You wear it with 튜브를 끼다 or float on it with 튜브를 타다. For squeeze tubes like toothpaste, put the contents first: 치약 튜브.
